originalSpatialBasis.sourceNotation: GPS centre 27°45′45.3″ N, 114°55′11.2″ E, with 30 m extensions east, south, west and north
originalSpatialBasis.coordinateReferenceSystem: Source datum unstated; WGS84 and CGCS2000 geographic interpretations retained as the finite plausible set
originalSpatialBasis.methodBasis: Transcribe the published DMS centre literally, evaluate the accepted WGS84 and CGCS2000 paths, use their coincident envelope centre, then round longitude and latitude to four decimal places.

publicEvidenceReference.label: Jiangxi sixth-batch protection-range annex, Xieli row

sourceCoordinatePrecision.explanation: Radial half-unit resolution of the published 0.1-second DMS notation, derived from approximately 1.37 m longitude and 1.55 m latitude components.

datumInterpretations.rationale: GPS broadcast positioning uses a WGS84 reference frame, making literal WGS84 geographic DMS a finite plausible interpretation without asserting that the source named it.
datumInterpretations.transformationMethod: Literal DMS-to-decimal identity conversion to WGS84 longitude and latitude.

datumInterpretations.rationale: CGCS2000 was the formal Chinese national geocentric frame before the annex and is a finite plausible interpretation for official GPS or GNSS control context.
datumInterpretations.transformationMethod: Preserve the geographic numerals at public map precision and apply a conservative outward frame allowance; no unsupported survey parameters are invented.

multiInterpretationEnvelope.method: The accepted WGS84 and CGCS2000 interpretation centres coincide at retained precision; bound the complete interpretation path by the conservative 1 m outward allowance.

supportArea.meaning: Source-described vicinity around the published GPS centre; not the archaeological extent, excavation, grave area or legal protection boundary.
supportArea.shape: 60 m by 60 m cardinal support square
supportArea.extentDescription: Thirty metres east, south, west and north from the published centre; the farthest unadjusted corner is approximately 42.43 m from the representative centre.
supportArea.sourceReferenceLabel: Jiangxi sixth-batch protection-range annex, Xieli row

representativePoint.selectionRule: Use the literal published centre shared by both accepted interpretation paths before four-decimal display rounding; do not substitute a provider pin, site centroid or entrance.

intentionalGeneralization.explanation: Deliberate displacement from rounding the literal transcription to [114.9198, 27.7626]; it is separate from source precision, datum allowance and support extent.

spatialBasis.label: Jiangxi sixth-batch protection-range annex, Xieli row
